def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    motifs = []
    for r in range(1, h-1):
        for c in range(1, w-1):
            if grid[r][c] == 2 and all(grid[rr][cc] == 3 for rr,cc in (
                (r-1,c-1),(r-1,c),(r-1,c+1),
                (r,c-1),(r,c+1),
                (r+1,c-1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1))):
                motifs.append((r,c))
    if not motifs:
        return out

    # The 2 rails run in the direction with the strongest full-length lines.
    row_score = max(sum(v == 2 for v in row) / w for row in grid)
    col_score = max(sum(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)) / h for c in range(w))
    vertical_rails = col_score >= row_score

    if vertical_rails:
        rails = {c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)) / h >= 0.65}
        rails.update(c for _,c in motifs)
        for r,c in motifs:
            # Extend the center line perpendicular to the rails.
            for cc in range(w):
                if out[r][cc] == 0:
                    out[r][cc] = 1
            # Copy the 3x3 hollow-square mark onto each other rail.
            for d in rails - {c}:
                for rr,cc in ((r-1,d-1),(r-1,d),(r-1,d+1),
                              (r,d-1),(r,d+1),
                              (r+1,d-1),(r+1,d),(r+1,d+1)):
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] != 3:
                        out[rr][cc] = 1
    else:
        rails = {r for r in range(h)
                 if sum(v == 2 for v in grid[r]) / w >= 0.65}
        rails.update(r for r,_ in motifs)
        for r,c in motifs:
            for rr in range(h):
                if out[rr][c] == 0:

            for d in rails - {r}:
                for rr,cc in ((d-1,c-1),(d-1,c),(d-1,c+1),
